memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Psoriasis
  - Status: New diagnosis, mild plaques on elbows and knees, no joint symptoms.
  - Plan: Start clobetasol 0.05% cream BD topically to affected areas; calcipotriol ointment OD topically; methotrexate 7.5 mg once weekly with folic acid 5 mg OD.
- Dyslipidaemia
  - Status: Newly identified, LDL 160 mg/dL, HDL 38 mg/dL, triglycerides 210 mg/dL.
  - Plan: Initiate atorvastatin 10 mg at bedtime; lifestyle modification.
- Weight 78 kg, waist circumference 92 cm (above male cut‑off 90 cm).
- Diet advice:
  - Breakfast: Whole grain toast, egg white, no added sugar.
  - Lunch: Vegetable salad with grilled chicken, limited oil.
  - Dinner: Lentil soup, steamed vegetables, small portion rice.
- Due: 2025-07-05 (next HbA1c).

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Psoriasis
  - Status: Plaques improved, mild residual scaling; no new lesions.
  - Plan: Continue clobetasol BD, calcipotriol OD; methotrexate 7.5 mg weekly unchanged.
- Dyslipidaemia
  - Status: LDL decreased to 130 mg/dL on atorvastatin; triglycerides 180 mg/dL.
  - Plan: Add rosuvastatin 10 mg OD for further LDL reduction; monitor CK.
- Weight 77 kg, waist 90 cm (at cut‑off).
- Diet advice:
  - Breakfast: Oats with skim milk, nuts.
  - Lunch: Mixed vegetable chapati, lean curd.
  - Dinner: Grilled fish, sautéed greens, small rice.
- Due: 2025-10-10 (next HbA1c).

  - Lunch: Quinoa salad with chickpeas, lemon dressing.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Psoriasis
  - Status: Flare – new erythematous plaques on scalp and lower back, mild itching.
  - Plan: Increase clobetasol to once daily for 2 weeks, then BD; add calcipotriol BD; consider short course oral methotrexate 10 mg weekly.
- Dyslipidaemia
  - Status: Stable LDL 112 mg/dL, HDL 41 mg/dL, triglycerides 148 mg/dL.
  - Plan: Continue current statins; advise dietary fat moderation.
- Weight 79 kg, waist 91 cm (above cut‑off).
- Diet advice:
  - Breakfast: Skip sugary cereal; have boiled eggs and whole grain toast.
  - Lunch: Reduce rice, increase vegetable curry.
  - Dinner: Avoid fried snacks; opt for steamed fish and salad.
- Due: 2026-05-20 (next HbA1c).
